description: Manage recurring scrape schedules. action=create runs a scrape of one or more URLs on a cron expression; action=list returns your schedules; action=delete removes one by schedule_id (it stops triggering). Every run spends credits like a scrape; minimum intervals depend on your balance tier.

schedule_id.description: delete: schedule id from create or list

timezone.description: create: timezone for the cron expression (default UTC)

urls.description: create: URLs to scrape on each run

webhook_url.description: create: HTTPS endpoint that receives results

name: alterlab_schedule
title: Scrape Schedules
